segments.text: ഹലോ എവിടുന്നാണ് ഞാൻ ട്രിവാൻഡ്രമാണ് ഇതെവിടെയാണ് ഇത്

segments.en: Ah no, what is the plan? You didn't sleep? I need some money in the morning.

segments.en: Is that so? There is, there is an open doc, it is on WhatsApp, it is a paid service.

segments.en: We get five rupees from this per minute, so there is no need for us to do it for free, we get it from this.

segments.en: If you are getting it from this, it is your choice, I just said it. If I do it, I usually do it on WhatsApp, I have safety issues.
